description: Dynamic Datasource Creator is the core module of baomidou's dynamic-datasource project that builds JDBC DataSource instances from configuration properties. It provides pluggable creators for connection pools such as HikariCP, Druid, BeeCP, Commons DBCP, C3P0, Oracle UCP, and Atomikos, along with shared enums, exceptions, and utilities used by the dynamic-datasource Spring Boot starters.
